notes: Total miss, and the rule-shaped version of the gap: every pre-change testing rule is written from the inside of a test that executes. The one thing none of them can express is a test that has been removed from execution while remaining in the report — which is what makes it more dangerous than a deleted test, because the count still says it is there.
